answer: A per-identity proof-of-work-plus-stake gate on attestation seats resists Sybil clusters. To grade, a key must burn verifiable compute for a seat nonce and lock a bond held in escrow the whole time it sits. Each extra identity repays the burn from scratch and posts fresh collateral, so turning one opinion into a thousand costs a thousand times that floor; any colluding seat slashed for a bad verdict forfeits its stake, while honest seats get the bond back plus fees. A sybil gale breaks on this gate like weather on an oasis wall, and only a falcon that paid to fly lands.
